subject: Micro reallocation plan for Q2/Q3 platform openings
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Micro reallocation plan for Q2/Q3 platform openings

Hi all,

We have a partial hiring freeze announced for non-critical IC bands effective Feb 1, and Talent has asked for a targeted reallocation plan that keeps critical delivery timelines intact while deferring lower-impact roles. I attached a small matrix (req_swap_matrix_q2q3.xlsx) that lists the 9 open reqs across Platform, Core Infra, and DevEx and a set of suggested swaps/holds.

Ask: please review and reply with (1) two roles you think can be deferred without blocking Ship X; (2) any reqs you want prioritized to keep offers moving; (3) compensation-band constraints that would force an exception. I need consolidated recommendations by EOD Monday (Feb 14) so Finance can run the delta.

Why this micro approach: leadership prefers targeted reallocation to wholesale freezes; this keeps momentum for customer-facing deliveries while limiting near-term spend. My initial thought is to hold 3 mid-band IC reqs and seek reserved spend approval for two senior infra hires if possible.

Attachments: req_swap_matrix_q2q3.xlsx, comp-band-impact-summary.pdf

Thanks,
Rishi
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Feb 2027 10:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Micro reallocation plan for Q2/Q3 platform openings

On Wed, Feb 10, 2027 at 9:12 AM Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com> wrote:
> We have a partial hiring freeze announced for non-critical IC bands effective Feb 1...

Thanks Rishi — reviewed the matrix. Quick notes:

- I can hold Platform-IC-3 (mid-band) and DevEx-IC-2 (mid-band) without materially impacting our roadmap; those two are lower priority.
- Platform-Sr-Infra-1 and CoreInfra-Sr-Cache-1 are high impact — I would push to keep offers moving for those two.
- Compensation flag: Platform-Sr-Infra-1 sits at the top of band D; we may need a band exception if market moves another 5% by offer time. I don’t think we can compress that without losing top candidates.

One ask: can we include a quick delta vs. committed headcount (F4 forecast) — I want to show managers the net hires deferred vs. backlog impact.

Marissa
Senior Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Feb 2027 11:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Micro reallocation plan for Q2/Q3 platform openings

Thanks — +1 to Marissa’s suggestions. A couple items from infra ops POV:

- Priority list: keep CoreInfra-Sr-Cache-1 and Platform-Sr-Infra-1 active (these affect latency SLAs).
- Suggested swap: move one open DevInfra-Tooling-IC req into a future Q3 hiring slot and use the freed capacity to accelerate Cloud Cost Engineer hire (we have a strong shortlist there).
- For the two senior infra reqs I recommend requesting reserved spend with Finance (Aditya) rather than band exceptions — it’s cleaner from an audit/compliance perspective.

I’ve attached a short cost impact summary in the matrix. Also flag: hiring vendor (talentops@hirewell.com) asked if paused reqs should be returned to the bench or kept active in ATS; we should decide a consistent state.

Vivek
VP, Core Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 08:55:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Micro reallocation plan for Q2/Q3 platform openings

Folks — thanks for the fast turn. A few operational items before sign-off:

- Finance needs a single table: net headcount change by band and the expected savings over the next three months. Aditya, can your team run the quick delta if Rishi or Talent supplies the final list?
- I approve holding Platform-IC-3 and DevEx-IC-2 per Marissa. I want two exceptions considered: (1) Platform-Sr-Infra-1 (keep moving), (2) Cloud Cost Engineer (accelerate). If Finance is OK with reserved spend for these, we keep hiring motion.
- On process: paused reqs should remain in ATS but moved to "On Hold - Strategic" status and TalentOps should pause active outreach. This preserves the pipeline without new offers.

If Aditya confirms the numbers tomorrow, we can route final sign-off to People & Finance by Wed morning.

Laura
VP, Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, talentops@hirewell.com
Date: Mon, 14 Feb 2027 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Micro reallocation plan for Q2/Q3 platform openings — Consolidated next steps

Thanks everyone — summary and next steps: 

1) Held (defer): Platform-IC-3, DevEx-IC-2 (Marissa approved).
2) Keep active (priority): Platform-Sr-Infra-1, CoreInfra-Sr-Cache-1 (Vivek/Marissa/Laura).
3) Accelerate: Cloud Cost Engineer (move into reserved spend request).
4) Process: TalentOps to set paused reqs to "On Hold - Strategic" and stop outbound. talentops@hirewell.com, please confirm you can set that status by EOD tomorrow.
5) Aditya: please produce a 3-month headcount delta + $ savings table using the attached comp-band-impact-summary.pdf and the matrix link. We need Finance+People sign-off by Wed 17 Feb 2027 11:00 PT.

If no objections, I’ll bundle this for exec sign-off and route for reserved spend approval for the two infra hires.

Rishi
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced: req_swap_matrix_q2q3.xlsx, comp-band-impact-summary.pdf
